claims.fact: The source specifies GSM×U1F, three SM chiral families plus three singlet RH neutrinos and one Higgs H with source Y=-1/2. All SM Yukawa couplings force universal Q,uR,dR,L,eR charges and fix FH via Eq5.2; RH-neutrino charges may remain family-dependent. No requirement to specify a neutrino mass mechanism is imposed on the gauge-matter inventory.

Define q=FQ, r=(Fn1+Fn2+Fn3)/3. Eq3.1 with universal SM species gives Fu=4q+r,Fd=-2q-r,FL=-3q,Fe=-6q-r;Eq5.2 gives FH=-3q-r. With ni=Fνi, the source conditions are sum ni=3r and sum ni^3=3r^3; these are source-family relations, not a new atlas anomaly gate. RHS ν_i become LH conjugates with X=-ni. The universal QYBL subfamily sets all ni=r; r!=0 retains the nonzero B-L component of P13 Eq45. Positive-Y atlas Higgs is the full scalar conjugate; no extra Higgs is added.

claims.fact: The rendered Eq3.2 prints Fe=FQ-Fu, inconsistent with Eq3.1 and the charged-lepton Yukawa relation. Use the unambiguous Eq3.1 sum relation Fe=-6q-r and retain this visible source discrepancy; do not silently trust the text extraction.

limitations: Symbolic family, not a single numerical theory; no numerical fingerprint is assigned before specialization.
Primitive gcd normalization is pointwise on the full inventory; parameter reparametrization and overlapping-family equivalence are not exhaustively quotiented.
Gauge-matter EFT only; no unspecified high-energy breaking sector or neutrino-mass completion is imported.
The QYBL family is a subfamily of the general Yukawa-compatible family; overlap is explicitly recorded, not claimed disjoint.
